plan.notes: Confirm what is being reviewed, in/out of scope, assumptions.
Copy templates into the review folder and fill seed.
Decompose into components/containers and write components.md (and seed). Decide component_mode: single vs per_component.

If component_mode=per_component: create `components/<component_slug>/` folders and copy templates from `.cbd/reviews/TEMPLATE/component/`.
Then expand `phases.review[]` with per-component work items by cloning these base items per component:
- WI-001 (contract map) → outputs: components/<component>/contract-map.md
- WI-002 (invariants) → outputs: components/<component>/invariants.md
- WI-005 (abuse cases) → outputs: components/<component>/abuse-cases.md
- WI-011 (STRIDE) → outputs: components/<component>/threats.stride.md
- WI-012 (LINDDUN, if applicable) → outputs: components/<component>/privacy.linddun.md
- WI-013 (ASVS, if applicable) → outputs: components/<component>/controls.asvs.md
Suggested ids: `WI-<component_slug>-001`, `WI-<component_slug>-002`, ... and optionally include `component: <component_slug>`.
Keep global work items for cross-cutting: assets, DFD, identity/authz, secrets/keys, reliability, observability/audit, supply chain, findings backlog.
Decide which frameworks apply (STRIDE/LINDDUN/ASVS). Pre-mark non-applicable items as skipped with justification. Minimum 1, maximum all 3.

review.description: Build contract surfaces & boundary map. If component_mode=per_component, do this per component (using components/<component>/contract-map.md) via per-component work items.
Catalog invariants (system/domain/safety) with enforcement and detection points. If component_mode=per_component, do per component invariants plus any global invariants.
Create asset inventory and data classification/redaction policy notes.
Write DFD notes: entities/processes/data stores/flows + explicit trust boundaries.
Enumerate abuse/misuse cases (negative scenarios) per entrypoint.
Review identity/authn/authz model: roles, enforcement points, replay protections.
Review secrets/key management: custody, rotation, redaction, signing boundaries.
Review reliability/failure semantics: retries, idempotency, restarts, bounds.
Review observability/auditability: logging, metrics, traces, audit trails.
Review supply-chain/dependency risk: high-risk deps, provenance, update strategy.
Run STRIDE threat modeling. If component_mode=per_component, do STRIDE per component/boundary and ensure threats reference DFD elements.
Run LINDDUN privacy threat modeling if applicable. If component_mode=per_component, do it per component. Otherwise mark skipped with justification.
Map control coverage using OWASP ASVS if applicable. If component_mode=per_component, do it per component. Otherwise mark skipped with justification.
Create findings backlog (machine-readable) with severities and recommended tasks.
Optional: promote accepted findings into `.cbd/tasks/*` and link back to this review.
review.notes: Do not create task IDs/files unless the human requests promotion.
